title: SBA-Observable Validation Scorecard
purpose: Validates the SCORING METHOD (fuzzy band mapping, weighted aggregation, centroid defuzzification) against real default outcomes. It does NOT validate the 49-criterion People's Bank tree, because no public dataset contains that tree's qualitative criteria. Keep the two claims separate in the thesis.
criticalNote: Bands below were set from a priori credit reasoning BEFORE any outcome was inspected, and were not tuned against the test set. The scorecard is therefore unfitted: it never sees a default label. That is the point of the comparison - it stands in for a bank that has no clean historical default data to train on, which is the common situation in Sri Lankan SME lending.

removedCriteria.reason: Both derive from the Term field, which research/src/leakage_analysis.py shows to be contaminated: whether Term is a multiple of 12 predicts default at AUC ~0.89 within every approval year, and 2007 approvals at 60 months defaulted at 11.1% against 86-92% at 59 and 61 months. Some of the term signal is genuinely economic, but the contaminated and legitimate components cannot be separated, so the whole field is excluded.

criteria.name: Guarantor share of facility
criteria.rationale: A high third-party guarantee share leaves the originating lender with little residual exposure, weakening screening incentives.

criteria.name: Established business (not a startup)
criteria.rationale: Direct analogue of the business-vintage criterion; startups lack a trading record to appraise.

criteria.name: Number of employees
criteria.rationale: Larger operations carry more organisational depth and are less dependent on a single proprietor.

criteria.name: Facility per employee
criteria.rationale: Very high borrowing per head signals leverage outrunning operating capacity.

criteria.name: Operates under a franchise
criteria.rationale: Franchise operations inherit tested systems, brand and supplier arrangements.

criteria.name: Revolving line of credit
criteria.rationale: Revolving facilities are drawn under stress and lack an amortisation discipline.

criteria.name: Disbursed vs approved
criteria.rationale: Full but not excessive drawdown indicates the facility was correctly sized at appraisal.

criteria.name: Low-documentation origination
criteria.rationale: Reduced-documentation lending means less verified information was available at appraisal.

objectives.name: Development Impact
objectives.note: Only employment outcomes are observable in SBA data. Women's participation, local raw-material usage, import substitution and foreign-exchange earnings - four of the nine items in clause 5 of the People's Bank form - have no public proxy. This objective is therefore PARTIALLY observable only, and the thesis must say so rather than implying the development objective was validated.

criteria.name: New jobs relative to existing workforce
